native_page_review.method: Read unchanged native captures alongside final Japanese/English source entries; measured pages and three name probes checked separately. Same assistant review.
native_page_review.findings: Speaker pages, yellow safe/flame spans, anonymous voice, two-line acquisition centring and Yes/No polarity agree with the source. Blacksmith ambition and banker obstacle were deliberately separated during bilingual review to avoid isolated overflow pages. Banking transaction menu and other results UI remain visibly Japanese and are outside this batch.
